name: Explosives
description: Substances/articles with a mass explosion or projection hazard

name: Gases
description: Compressed, liquefied, or dissolved gases -- flammable, non-flammable, or toxic

name: Flammable liquids
description: Liquids with a flash point at or below 60 C

name: Flammable solids
description: Solids liable to spontaneous combustion or that emit flammable gas on contact with water

name: Oxidizing substances and organic peroxides
description: Substances that readily yield oxygen, or organic peroxides

name: Toxic and infectious substances
description: Substances liable to cause death or serious injury if ingested/inhaled/contacted

name: Radioactive material
description: Material emitting ionizing radiation above defined activity concentration

name: Corrosives
description: Substances that cause severe damage to living tissue or materials on contact

name: Miscellaneous dangerous goods
description: Substances/articles presenting a danger not covered by other classes
